newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction sees mixed fortunes for landeds.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction sees mixed fortunes for landeds.

text.p: The London tea auction saw good overall demand for landed teas but interest in offshores was down, the official report said.
Prices for Bright East Africans and coloury mediums were firm while good mediums saw increases of one-three pence per kg.
Mediums fell four-eight pence per kg while rates for East African PDs and good liquoring Assams were also easier.
Prices for offshores were also down, the report said.
